signal: CAI Software merged with Print ePS (Oct 2025), named Brent Pietrzak CEO, and acquired Mar-Kov

email.subject1: a signal play for CAI Software
email.body1:
Neil, saw CAI Software complete the Print ePS merger, bring on Brent Pietrzak as CEO, and fold in Mar-Kov.

Three moves like that open far more accounts across your divisions than reps can cover while everything integrates, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for CAI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Neil, quick follow-up for CAI Software.

With three new divisions to cover, pipeline expectations usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings CAI needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Neil, last bit of proof for CAI Software.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how CAI's reply rate likely compares to other manufacturing-ERP teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Neil, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling CAI's pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority right now, no problem at all. A merger plus an acquisition is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a manufacturing-ERP motion? I'll tailor it to CAI either way.
